final_answer:
**Most overdue open work order: WO-2026-00047 — Battery Tray Base Pan (formed), qty 120, planned end 2026-02-25, 236 days past due** (status stopped, is_late=true, no projected finish). Currency is INR.

**Why late**
The one blocking cause is that the subcontract was never sent. Purchase record SCO-2026-00038 to vendor Rajendra Naik is still in draft with an expected delivery of 2026-03-03, so the order is held by an event with no known date.
Where it is stuck: the very first operation, JC-2026-00139 "Laser Cut Blank" on LASER-01 Trumpf TruLaser 3030, is open, never started, 0 of 120 done, waiting 245 days since its 2026-02-16 start. The two later cards, JC-2026-00140 (Deburr & Edge Break, ASSY-01) and JC-2026-00141 (Press Brake Form Pan, PB-01 Amada HFE 1303), are also open and untouched.
Contributing (non-blocking) signals: the order is stopped with no recorded reason; schedule capacity ceiling on WS-2026-00001 (720 min) and WS-2026-00009 (480 min); a subcontract still pending; downtime recorded on the order at PB-02 Energy Mac 100T — quality_issue, 202.21 minutes; and workstation downtime on PB-01 Amada HFE 1303 (417.37 min over 2 setup_change entries) and ASSY-01 (45 min, one tool_change).
No cost has been recorded: expected and actual are both 0, so no variance can be given.

**What it blocks**
These are potential consumers found by BOM matching, so they *may* be affected, not confirmed blocked: WO-2026-00116, WO-2026-00101, WO-2026-00086, WO-2026-00071, WO-2026-00056 (all Battery Tray Weldment sub-assy), and one level further WO-2026-00106, WO-2026-00091, WO-2026-00076, WO-2026-00061 (EV Battery Tray Assembly 2400).
Customer impact is "known". Potential exposure through those consumers, all to Bharat EV Motors Ltd:
- SO-2026-00171 — delivery 2026-07-12, INR 2,219,635.79, undelivered (via WO-2026-00091)
- SO-2026-00151 — delivery 2026-06-10, INR 2,693,620.93, undelivered (via WO-2026-00076)
- SO-2026-00021 — delivery 2026-08-18, INR 456,695.40, undelivered (via WO-2026-00106)
- SO-2026-00050 — delivery 2026-09-16, INR 1,174,359.60, already delivered (via WO-2026-00061)
No sales order is linked directly to WO-2026-00047 itself.

**Rescheduling**
Nothing could be written. Every proposal — for WO-2026-00047 and for WO-2026-00116, WO-2026-00101, WO-2026-00086, WO-2026-00106, WO-2026-00091, WO-2026-00076 — came back with no new dates, date_committable=false, writable_by_seat=false, because there is no committable date: subcontract_not_sent. A person needs to release subcontract SCO-2026-00038 (or set its delivery), after which dates can be proposed again.

**Not visible to me**
Nothing was withheld from this seat on this request.

One thing to flag: the item name on WO-2026-00047 is wrapped in record-text markers, and the vendor name on SCO-2026-00038 and the workstation label inside its downtime signal are too. That is text typed by whoever created those rows — it contained no instruction to me, and I treated it only as evidence.
